title: Product Catalog Management

use_cases.name: Add Product
use_cases.service_call: ProductServiceImpl.addProduct(name, type, info, price, quantity, InputStream image)
use_cases.notes: Admin-only; session check usertype==admin; forwards to addProduct.jsp

use_cases.name: Update Product
use_cases.db_op: UPDATE product SET pname,ptype,pinfo,pprice,pquantity WHERE pid
use_cases.notes: Admin-only; if quantity increased, triggers demand notifications via DemandServiceImpl + MailMessage; forwards to updateProduct.jsp

use_cases.name: Remove Product
use_cases.db_op: DELETE FROM product WHERE pid; DELETE FROM usercart WHERE prodid
use_cases.notes: Admin-only; also cascades removal from usercart; forwards to removeProduct.jsp

use_cases.name: Browse Product Catalog
service_calls: ProductServiceImpl.getAllProductsByType(type) → SELECT * FROM product WHERE ptype LIKE ?
ProductServiceImpl.searchAllProducts(search) → SELECT * FROM product WHERE ptype/pname/pinfo LIKE ?
use_cases.notes: No servlet dedicated to listing in srv/; invoked from JSP or other components

use_cases.name: View Product Details
use_cases.notes: Returns ProductBean with id, name, type, info, price, quantity, image stream

use_cases.name: View Product Image
use_cases.service_call: ProductServiceImpl.getImage(prodId) → SELECT image FROM product WHERE pid=?
use_cases.notes: Returns byte[] image; falls back to noimage.jpg if null; writes directly to ServletOutputStream

key_relationships: ProductServiceImpl depends_on DemandServiceImpl (notify waiting customers on restock)
ProductServiceImpl depends_on UserServiceImpl (get customer first name for email)
include_extend_relationships: UC2 (Update Product) <<include>> Notify Waiting Customers — triggered when quantity increases
UC1/UC2/UC3 <<extend>> Validate Admin Session — guard: usertype==admin in HttpSession

service_interface.name: ProductService
methods: addProduct(name, type, info, price, quantity, InputStream): String

important_notes: All admin servlets enforce session guard (usertype==admin); doPost delegates to doGet. ProductBean attributes: prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity, prodImage. No Spring/DI — servlets directly instantiate ProductServiceImpl. removeProduct cascades delete to usercart table.
